title: Chevron's Microsoft Data Center Deal Was a Bigger Story Than Its Earnings. Here's Why.
title_zh: 雪佛龙与微软数据中心的交易比其收益更重要。这就是为什么。
summary: Chevron is getting in on the AI boom with its recent long-term energy agreement with Microsoft.
summary_zh: 雪佛龙最近与微软签署了长期能源协议，加入了人工智能热潮。

title: Nobody's Talking About This Energy Company, but It's Quietly Signing the Power Deals Feeding the AI Build-Out
title_zh: 没有人谈论这家能源公司，但它正在悄悄签署电力协议，为人工智能的发展提供动力
summary: Clearway Energy is emerging as a key player in AI power.
summary_zh: Clearway Energy 正在成为人工智能领域的关键参与者。

title: Will EA’s €250 Million Bundesliga Rights Deal Reshape Its Live-Services Football Narrative (EA)?
title_zh: EA 2.5 亿欧元的德甲版权交易会重塑其直播服务足球叙事 (EA)吗？
summary: Electronic Arts has entered a multi-year €250 million licensing agreement with Germany's Bundesliga, securing rights to all 36 clubs across the top two leagues for authentic use of images, logos, and player likenesses in its football games.
summary_zh: 美国艺电公司 (Electronic Arts) 与德国德甲联赛 (Bundesliga) 签订了一份价值 2.5 亿欧元的多年期许可协议，获得了两大联赛的所有 36 支俱乐部在其足球比赛中真实使用图像、徽标和球员肖像的权利。

title: Bandwidth (BAND) Could Be 27% Undervalued As Salesforce Deal And Outlook Lift Reset Views
title_zh: 随着 Salesforce 交易和 Outlook 提升重置视图，带宽 (BAND) 可能被低估 27%
summary: Bandwidth (BAND) is back on investor radar after reporting robust revenue growth from its voice and messaging services, securing an exclusive infrastructure partnership with Salesforce, and lifting its full year outlook for revenue and adjusted EBITDA.
summary_zh: Bandwidth (BAND) 在报告语音和消息服务收入强劲增长、与 Salesforce 建立独家基础设施合作伙伴关系、上调全年收入预期和调整后 EBITDA 后，重新受到投资者关注。

title: The Goldman Sachs Group (GS) Just Made Its Fourth Asset-Management Deal in a Year
title_zh: 高盛集团 (GS) 刚刚完成一年内的第四笔资产管理交易
summary: On August 18, 2026, The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. (NYSE:GS) agreed to buy real estate investment firm LCN Capital Partners for up to $410 million, its fourth asset-management acquisition in less than a year and second deal in under 10 days.
summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月 18 日，高盛集团 (NYSE:GS) 同意以高达 4.1 亿美元的价格收购房地产投资公司 LCN Capital Partners，这是其不到一年内的第四次资产管理收购，也是不到 10 天内的第二笔交易。
